headline: GFL Limited approves standalone and consolidated financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: September quarter results out at GFL Limited

modes.bear: Without headline figures provided in the filing, earnings quality and margin trends remain unverified until reviewed.
modes.bull: Financial results are officially out, providing clarity on the company's recent operational performance and earnings.
modes.simple: GFL Limited has officially released its financial performance numbers for the quarter ending in September.

summary: GFL Limited announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, following a board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The board reviewed and approved the financial statements along with the limited review report from independent auditors. Investors can examine the filings to assess the company's financial health and performance over the period.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the current financial standing of GFL Limited.

headline: GFL Limited receives certified NCLT order for its scheme of arrangement
summary: GFL Limited announced that it has received the certified true copy of the final NCLT order regarding its scheme of arrangement, following a hearing held on September 28, 2026. The appointed date for the scheme is set for April 1, 2026. Retail shareholders should note this procedural milestone as the corporate restructuring moves forward.
why_it_matters: Corporate restructuring advances for GFL Limited shareholders.
